# Lib.numbers.vec4

## Operators

- [**DotVec4**](DotVec4.md) — Applies a dot product to two Vec4's
- [**PickColor**](PickColor.md) — Selects and switches between any of the connected colors
- [**RgbaToColor**](RgbaToColor.md) — Creates a Color from 4 values (RGBA)
- [**Vector4Components**](Vector4Components.md) — Converts a Vector4 (or RGBA Color) into three individual values.
